perspective:
Maria Ortega’s available information:

- She noticed Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project.
- She offered to help Cheryl, and Cheryl accepted, saying she could definitely use the help.
- She helped Cheryl with the project afterward.
- She observed Cheryl handling responsibilities better and showing growing confidence.
- At a staff meeting, she suggested Cheryl for a leadership role.
- The team leader called it a good suggestion and asked Cheryl about it.
- Cheryl thanked Maria and said she was ready to take on the challenge.
- Maria privately approached Cheryl afterward to make sure Cheryl felt supported rather than pressured.
- Cheryl told Maria she had been a bit surprised but appreciated Maria’s support and said it meant a lot that Maria believed in her.
- Maria then proposed that they co-lead the project together.
- Cheryl agreed enthusiastically, saying Maria’s guidance had been invaluable and that they made a great team.
- Afterward, Maria and Cheryl successfully collaborated on several projects.
- Maria proposed teaming up for more future projects.
- Cheryl said she would love that, called working with Maria a wonderful experience, and said she was excited about what they could achieve together.
